post.title: How Attio Uses Rightbrain to Build an AI Account Researcher
post.subtitle: See how Attio's revenue team automated account research with a custom AI Task, cutting prep time from hours to minutes.
post.body_html:
The challenge: manual account research at scale

Attio's revenue team was spending hours each week manually researching prospect accounts before outreach. Pulling together company news, recent funding, product changes, and key personnel updates from dozens of sources made personalised outreach slow and inconsistent.

They needed a way to automate this research without sacrificing the depth and accuracy that made their outreach stand out.

The solution: a Rightbrain Task for account intelligence

Using Rightbrain's Task builder, Attio created a custom AI Task that accepts a company URL and a sales rep's context notes, then returns a structured account brief — in under 60 seconds.

What the Task does

  • Fetches and summarises the company's public web presence
  • Identifies recent news, funding rounds, and product launches
  • Surfaces relevant pain points mapped to Attio's ICP criteria
  • Outputs a structured JSON brief the sales rep can paste directly into their CRM

The Rightbrain setup

The Task uses the url_fetcher input processor to pull live content from the prospect's domain, then passes it — along with the rep's notes — to a Claude Sonnet model with a custom system prompt tuned for B2B account intelligence.

The output is structured JSON with fields for company summary, recent signals, recommended talking points, and a personalisation hook for the first email.

Results

Since deploying the Account Researcher Task, Attio's revenue team has seen:

  • Average research time reduced from 45 minutes to under 3 minutes per account
  • Outreach open rates up 18% — attributed to more timely and relevant personalisation
  • Consistent brief quality across the whole team, regardless of experience level

Rightbrain gave us a way to put AI directly into our existing workflow, not alongside it. The Task runs inside our CRM via webhook — no context switching required.

How to replicate this

You can build a similar Account Researcher in Rightbrain using these steps:

  1. Create a new Task in the Rightbrain dashboard.
  2. Add a url input parameter (type: string).
  3. Enable the URL Fetcher input processor and map it to the url parameter.
  4. Write a system prompt that instructs the model to extract company signals relevant to your ICP.
  5. Set the output modality to JSON and define the output format schema.
  6. Test with a few prospect URLs, then connect via webhook to your CRM.
